narrative:
Hancock County has 49,891 registered voters, with 51.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.7% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 9.9%, a pronounced Republican lean of 28.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.0% of registrants.
